{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the population: only 'completed' orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_only))

# Check revenue column: it's a string with commas
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample of revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_mask = (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99')
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print("Number of QA orders:", qa_count)

# Confirm they are not in the completed group
qa_in_completed = qa_mask & (sales['status'] == 'completed')
print("QA orders among completed:", qa_in_completed.sum())"}
